newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville offers no peak firm power for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville offers no peak firm power for Thursday.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) did not offer any firm power for delivery during peak demand hours on Thursday, compared with recent offers of 200 megawatts a day, the agency said Wednesday.
Previously for Wednesday, BPA had offered peak firm power at $16.50 per MWh in the Northwest and at $17.50 at the California Oregon Border (COB).
Thursday prices for light-load firm power were unchanged at $9.00 for both the Northwest and COB.
BPA prices for non-firm power during hours ending 0100 to 0500 and 2400 PDT on Thursday were also unchanged at $7.00 for Northwest and $8.00 at COB.
Non-firm power during hours ending 0600, 0700 and 2300 was unchanged at $10.00 and the agency offered non-firm power during hours ending 0800 and 0900 at $13.00 for the Northwest and $14.00 at COB.
